# Escorpio

> Escorpio is a USDG money desk on Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663). It compares Morpho vault rates and Morpho loans
> against stock tokens, then lets people deposit, withdraw, borrow and repay from their own wallet. Escorpio never
> holds funds and has no smart contract of its own. Nothing it shows is financial advice.

## MCP server

Add `https://escorpio.pro/mcp` as a remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no key, no login). Read-only tools:

- `get_best_rates`: best open USDG vault, cheapest loan per collateral, widest rate gap
- `list_vaults`: USDG vaults, best net rate first (`open_only`, `limit`)
- `list_markets`: USDG loan markets, cheapest first (`collateral`, `limit`)
- `explain_risk_notes`: what every risk note means

Quote `readAt` with any rate. Never call a rate safe or guaranteed. To act, send people to the Earn or Borrow page,
where they sign with their own wallet.

## Public API

OpenAPI description: [openapi.json](https://escorpio.pro/openapi.json)


No key, no login. JSON, open to any origin. Each reading is at most one minute old and says when it was read
(`readAt`). Rates are percent per year, money is US dollars.

- [GET /api/rates](https://escorpio.pro/api/rates): best open USDG vault, cheapest loan per collateral, widest rate gap
- [GET /api/vaults](https://escorpio.pro/api/vaults): every USDG vault, best net rate first; `?open=1` for open ones only
- [GET /api/markets](https://escorpio.pro/api/markets): every USDG loan market, cheapest first; `?collateral=<address or symbol>`
- [GET /api/desk](https://escorpio.pro/api/desk): the raw Morpho answer the site reads, unchanged

Every vault and market carries `notes`: risk notes in plain words. A note with `"stop": true` is a reason not to use
it right now. No note does not mean safe.

## Pages

- [Home](https://escorpio.pro/): how much idle USDG would earn at today's best open vault rate
- [Earn](https://escorpio.pro/earn): every USDG vault, deposit and withdraw
- [Borrow](https://escorpio.pro/borrow): every USDG loan market per collateral, borrow and repay
- [Method](https://escorpio.pro/method): where every number comes from and what each risk note means

## Contracts

- USDG: 0x5fc5360D0400a0Fd4f2af552ADD042D716F1d168
- Morpho Blue: 0x9D53d5E3bd5E8d4Cbfa6DB1ca238AEA02E651010
